job.rawJd:
Job Title

Associate Director, Client Strategy

About OX

The Office of Experience (OX) is a full-service digital agency helping companies excel at every moment of interface they have with their customers. OX's human-centered philosophy and multidisciplinary approach integrate strategy, design and technology to help organizations reinvent their business and rapidly bring new experiences, products and messages to market. In an era of unprecedented disruption, OX is built to transform.

Position Description

The Associate Director, Client Strategy is a key role in the organization with the ability to steward and support your clients' businesses as if they are your own. As Associate Director, Client Strategy, you'll manage day-to-day client relationships and define the strategic direction of projects, ensuring the successful delivery of work while identifying new opportunities to grow existing accounts. You'll lead strategic account planning that drives revenue and profitability for OX, and you'll direct multi-disciplinary teams to keep projects on strategy, on budget, and on time. Partnering with a Director or Senior Director, you'll act as the client's proxy within the agency, bringing a deep understanding of the client's brand, business and priorities to every discussion. The Associate Director, Client Strategy reports directly to the Senior Director, Client Strategy.

Responsibilities & Duties

Co-manage a portfolio of accounts and multi-disciplinary teams with a focus on building a deep understanding of each client's business to guide strategic decisions
Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and partner in translating them into actionable strategies and scoped work
Brief internal teams on the client's business and the goals of each project
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop strategically sound and sufficiently detailed scopes of work, proposals and project briefs, and to ensure that client efforts deliver on time, on budget and on strategy
Consult with clients on opportunities, approaches and solutions, partnering with discipline leads to bring the right expertise to the table
Learn and collaborate with peers, mentors and managers in a multi-disciplinary environment
Support management of client financial projections and oversee account growth and profitability
Other duties as assigned by your manager

Required Experience

6+ years of experience in a strategic or client services role in a professional services, agency or consulting environment
Experience managing account financials, including budgets, forecasting, and profitability
Understanding of the principles and practices of omnichannel marketing, eCommerce and emergent technologies to drive outcomes for B2B and B2C businesses and brands
Strong client management and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and consult on opportunities and engagements
Strong oral and written communication and presentation skills

Location

Chicago / Remote with the ability to work in-person as needed

paragraphs: I am applying for the Associate Director, Client Strategy role at OX. I spent eight years in agency account management, progressing from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor while leading Fortune 500 relationships, multichannel programs, budgets, scopes, and financial reporting. The work that followed in UX, analytics, and AI showed me how strategy, design, and technology decisions shape what clients can actually use.

At FCB Health, I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business and managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch. I led three national television commercials in one year across research, med-legal review, production, and network clearance. The spots drove a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks. Earlier, on the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, I owned weekly client status and financial reporting, multichannel delivery, and annual strategic recommendations.

At Scout Marketing, I was promoted to Account Supervisor / Digital Strategist and led Jazz Pharmaceuticals consumer work across digital, print, social, and in-office channels. At RosettaWishbone, I was the primary contact across client teams, affiliates, and vendors and owned briefs, scopes of work, stakeholder communication, status, and financial reports. That is the account work I know. Learn the client's business, give the team clear direction, and put enough detail behind the scope that the group can deliver it.

Since then, I have grown a distributed design team from 2 to 30, helped build a repeatable digital audit workflow, and led client discovery for working AI and product prototypes. I also designed an agency finance tool for regional rate cards and natural-language scope changes. My direct financial record covers budgets up to $20M, weekly reporting, scopes, and rate-card workflows. This role would extend that foundation through more formal forecasting and profitability responsibility.

OX is appealing because client service, experience design, and practical technology have all been part of my career. I would welcome a conversation about how that mix could help the client-strategy team.

resume.summary: Client strategy leader with eight years in agency account management. I bring agency account leadership strengthened by later strategy, team, and technology delivery. I managed Fortune 500 relationships and budgets up to $20M, owned client status and financial reporting, and guided brand planning, briefs, scopes, timelines, and multichannel programs. My later UX, analytics, and AI work taught me how to guide multidisciplinary teams through complex decisions and into practical plans.
